note: owner 14 Nov (Instagram's own best practice: add a LOCATION to reach people in that place). The Instagram place tag of a district page's posts (districts/pipeline.py, location_id on the media container). Read in the repo only - no place search at runtime. id = the Facebook Page id of the PLACE page (graph.facebook.com location_id; old Instagram explore ids are refused - Namakkal 30-31 Oct). Only an id made of digits is used; an empty id = no tag (as before). TODO OWNER: fill each id after checking it is the right place: open https://www.facebook.com/<id> and see the place name. Whether Instagram accepts it shows after the first post: 'location tag: <place> (<id>)' in the job log, or the id in districts/state/<key>/locations_refused.json. Power-cut posts always get the city tag (a cut covers many areas); other news gets the area named FIRST in the Tamil headline (then the English headline, the reel's place line, the location column), else the city. match = words found inside the headline (Tamil stems, so தாம்பரத்தில் matches தாம்பர); not = longer words that are another place (திருப்போரூர் holds போரூர்). An id Instagram refuses is written to districts/state/<key>/locations_refused.json and never tried again - fix the id here and delete that file.
